_doc: Reward-design DOCTRINE for the AI Build agent — pure TEACHING data, no rule engine. Restores the per-term design knowledge the projection strips (the agent otherwise sees only name/min/max/default/polarity) so it can reason DIALECTICALLY (辩证面), learn POSTURE alongside command tracking (姿态), and self-audit for degenerate LOCAL OPTIMA (局部解审视). This is advisory: it teaches, it never forces or gates — a task may legitimately omit any of these (the LLM judges). Consumed by ai_orchestration.registry_projection (surfaced in the agent vocabulary) + the rewards-block self-review turn + the critic prompt. User overlay: <USER_CONFIG_DIR>/registers/reward_doctrine_custom.json (id-clash → user wins). term_categories MUST cover every shipped IL_REWARD_REGISTRY / REWARD_REGISTRY key (a unit test enforces this — a new uncategorized term simply gets no hint at runtime, never a crash). term_hints is a flat term-key → hint map (a term key means the same thing across backends; where names differ they are separate keys).

categories.desc: reward for following the task command / objective (commanded velocity, yaw, goal, reference) — bounded exp forms SATURATE at large error
penalty on command-tracking ERROR (unbounded) — the dialectical counterpart that removes the standing local-optimum
penalty on base motion the command never asked for (vertical bounce, roll/pitch wobble, off-axis speed)
keeps a stable body posture (level base, target height, clean stance) alongside command tracking
keeps joints near a sane pose / off their limits (may live on a pd-group page for a joint subset)
small smoothness / energy regularizers — tiny weights only; too large freezes the joints
stepping rhythm & coordination (phasing, stride duration, foot clearance) — some are farmable alone and need a phasing partner
penalizes bad contact (foot slide/slip, collisions, contact on bodies that should not touch ground)
survival / termination shaping — keep small relative to task pressure or it invites survive-to-wall

term_hints.track_lin_vel_xy: Bounded exp velocity tracking — SATURATES at large error, so a still robot under a command feels almost no gradient. Alone it permits a standing local-optimum; pair with track_fail_penalty (unbounded) when you want real following.
term_hints.track_ang_vel_z: Bounded exp yaw-rate tracking; keep it ~half of track_lin_vel_xy or the robot is rewarded for turning over moving.
term_hints.track_body_height_cmd: Tracks a commanded base height; a command-tracking term (bounded).
term_hints.track_fail_penalty: The dialectical counterpart of track_* — UNBOUNDED command-relative error ||actual-cmd||² with a gradient EVERYWHERE (including from a dead standstill), so it removes the standing local-optimum. Penalizes command-RELATIVE error, not absolute speed, so a zero/stand command stays ~free.
term_hints.lin_vel_z_penalty: Penalizes vertical base bounce the command never asked for (base-motion penalty).
term_hints.ang_vel_xy_penalty: Penalizes roll/pitch base wobble the command never asked for (base-motion penalty).
term_hints.ang_vel_z_penalty: Penalizes ABSOLUTE yaw rate — don't apply it against a turning command (it would fight yaw tracking).
term_hints.lin_vel_xy_penalty: Penalizes ABSOLUTE horizontal speed — a documented foot-gun that silently kills locomotion if applied under a nonzero command. Usually 0; only for a stand-only item.
term_hints.flat_orientation: Posture — keeps the base level; a core posture term to learn alongside command tracking.
term_hints.base_height: Posture — holds a target base height (set its Value); stops crouching to game other terms.
term_hints.stand_still: Rewards a clean, level, all-feet-planted stance ONLY under a ~zero command (silent while moving). Route it to a stand item to fix 'floats two legs while standing'.
term_hints.joint_deviation_l1: Joint-regularization — keeps joints near their default pose; without it the policy thrashes/contorts. May live on a pd-group page for a joint subset.
term_hints.dof_pos_limits: Joint-regularization — penalizes riding the joint position limits; guards against limit-slamming postures.
term_hints.joint_torque_penalty: Effort regularizer — tiny weight only; too large starves/freezes the joints.
term_hints.joint_accel_penalty: Effort regularizer — very tiny weight only.
term_hints.energy_penalty: Effort regularizer — very tiny weight only.
term_hints.action_rate_penalty: Smoothness — penalizes jerky action changes; a small stabilizer, not a locomotion driver.
term_hints.gait: Clock-free diagonal antiphase — the anti-single-leg guard: a single-leg twitch scores 0.5 < a real trot; standing/pronk score 0; cannot be farmed statically. Pair with feet_air_time / feet_clearance to force a real, self-organized rhythm.
term_hints.feet_air_time: Pure stride-DURATION shaping (long swings rewarded at touchdown); makes NO velocity check, so a LONE air-time reward is farmed by a single-leg twitch. Pair with gait and route only to items where stepping is wanted.
term_hints.feet_clearance: Rewards lifting the swing foot; like feet_air_time it needs a phasing partner (gait) or one exaggerated leg farms it.
term_hints.track_gait_phase: Tracks a commanded gait phase (stepping rhythm).
term_hints.track_swing_height_cmd: Tracks a commanded swing-foot height (stepping shaping).
term_hints.feet_slide: Penalizes feet sliding while in contact (contact term); makes steps plant instead of skate.
term_hints.undesired_contacts: Penalizes contact on bodies that should not touch ground (thighs/hips/base); keeps the gait clean.
term_hints.alive_reward: Constant per-step survival bonus. Keep it SMALL relative to tracking — a large alive bonus with weak command pressure invites survive-to-wall (just don't fall).
term_hints.termination_penalty: One-shot penalty at episode termination; discourages falling. With a big alive bonus and no command penalty it can still yield survive-to-wall.
term_hints.velocity_tracking: SB3 body-frame velocity tracking (bounded, saturates); pair with track_fail_penalty for real following — same logic as the IL track_* terms.
term_hints.yaw_tracking: SB3 yaw-rate tracking; keep ~half of velocity_tracking.
term_hints.joint_pose_tracking: SB3 joint-pose tracking toward a reference pose.
term_hints.joint_vel_tracking: SB3 joint-velocity tracking toward a reference.
term_hints.goal_distance: SB3 manipulator task reward — closer to the goal scores higher (the 'command' for reach tasks).
term_hints.grasp_success: SB3 manipulator success bonus — sparse task reward.
term_hints.upright: SB3 posture — keeps the base upright (the flat_orientation analog).
term_hints.angular_rate_penalty: SB3 base-motion penalty on angular rate.
term_hints.lateral_penalty: SB3 base-motion penalty on lateral drift; don't apply against a strafe command.
term_hints.energy: SB3 effort regularizer — small weight only.
term_hints.foot_air_time: SB3 stride-duration reward; SB3 has NO gait phasing term, so guard single-leg farming with per-item routing + posture rather than a phasing pair.
term_hints.alive: SB3 survival bonus — keep small vs tracking (survive-to-wall risk).

principles.name: 辩证面 / dialectical
principles.text: Every reward for doing X invites the question of a penalty for NOT doing X. Bounded command-tracking rewards SATURATE (a still robot feels no gradient), so a following task usually also wants the unbounded command penalty (track_fail_penalty) plus base-motion penalties for motion the command never asked for.

principles.name: 姿态 / posture
principles.text: Learn command-tracking AND posture together — flat_orientation / joint_deviation_l1 / dof_pos_limits / base_height — so the policy holds a stable posture, not only a velocity.

principles.name: 局部解审视 / local-optima review
principles.text: After configuring, abstract each reward into a boundary constraint and ask what actually maximizes the sum — can the policy score well while standing, lifting one leg, or just surviving? If so, add the counter-term.

caveat: These are REASONING principles, not a fixed checklist. Use judgment for the specific task — a task may legitimately omit gait; a manipulation task needs different terms. Each reward's category and hint tell you what it pairs with and which degenerate optimum it guards against. Never add a term just to satisfy a rule.

degenerate_optima.name: standing / stuck-still
degenerate_optima.tell: a command-tracking reward is present but no unbounded command penalty, so the saturated tracking reward is already near-max while the robot stands
degenerate_optima.consider: track_fail_penalty (IL) / a fail penalty on velocity_tracking (SB3)

degenerate_optima.name: single-leg-lift
degenerate_optima.tell: feet_air_time / feet_clearance present with no phasing guard, so one exaggerated leg farms the stride reward
degenerate_optima.consider: gait on the same item (IL); on SB3 route air-time only to stepping items

degenerate_optima.name: survive-to-wall
degenerate_optima.tell: alive / termination shaping dominates while command pressure is weak, so the policy just avoids falling
degenerate_optima.consider: keep alive small and keep a command / base-motion penalty active

degenerate_optima.name: posture drift / limb flailing
degenerate_optima.tell: no posture or joint-regularization term, so the policy contorts to game other rewards

degenerate_optima.name: zero-command floating
degenerate_optima.tell: a stand item has no stand_still and no posture penalty, so the robot floats two legs while 'standing'
degenerate_optima.consider: stand_still or a posture penalty on the stand item
